chung.Description:
This practicum course is designed to give students the opportunity to apply theoretical knowledge learned before to actual multimedia production situations. This course incorporates in its approach a combination of applied media aesthetics theory and hands-on production experience in video production. Students will gain a foundation for understanding media production theory, facilitating video production processes as well as creating and evaluating media products relating to a particular issue set by the course lecturer. A component of the course will permit the introduction of current topics such as media issues, professional video production techniques, changing media technology, and job market information. In addition, the course will also introduce some applications of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the video production process, allowing students to explore and utilize these advanced technologies to enhance the efficiency and quality of their media products.
As a student of the class, you will sample a variety of production work through active team participation. Based on the quality of the video, your product might be published on FPT’s media platforms.

clo: Explain fundamental video production principles and techniques by describing the stages of production (pre-production, production, and post-production) and the functions of key roles within a production crew.

Analyze the impact of scriptwriting, visual elements, and audio elements on storytelling by identifying key techniques in scripting, camera work, lighting, sound, and editing that enhance narrative flow and audience engagement.
Apply technical skills in operating video production equipment, including cameras, lighting systems, and audio devices, to capture high-quality footage.
Edit video and audio content proficiently using industry-standard software, focusing on continuity, pacing, transitions, and the integration of visual and sound effects to strengthen storytelling.
Use AI tools to enhance production efficiency and optimize workflow in tasks such as content planning, editing support, asset generation, and post-production enhancement.
Demonstrate effective teamwork and communication skills by collaborating within a production team, coordinating tasks, sharing responsibilities, and managing conflicts professionally.
Exhibit professional responsibility and ethical standards in video production by respecting copyright, privacy, and cultural sensitivity throughout all stages of content creation and distribution.
